scheme.ministry: Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare
scheme.description: Direct income support of Rs 6000 per year paid in 3 equal installments of Rs 2000 every four months via DBT. All landholding farmer families irrespective of land size eligible (revised from initial 2 ha limit on 01.06.2019). Land cut-off date: 01.02.2019 for determining landholding eligibility. Aadhaar mandatory. Bank account with IFSC mandatory.
scheme.voice_summary: PM-KISAN gives land-holding farmer families 6000 rupees a year, paid in three instalments of 2000 rupees directly into their bank account.
benefits: Rs 6000 per year income support to farmer families
eligibility: Must be a landholding farmer family with cultivable land in their name (any size from 01.06.2019)
Cultivable land must be in the name of the farmer family
application_process: offline: Visit the nearest Common Service Centre (CSC) or local Patwari / Revenue Officer / Nodal Agriculture Officer.
offline: Submit land records, Aadhaar, and bank passbook for verification.
online: Visit official PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) -> Farmers Corner -> 'New Farmer Registration'.
online: Select Rural Farmer Registration or Urban Farmer Registration.
online: Enter Aadhaar Number and Mobile Number, select State, and verify OTP.
online: Fill personal, bank, and land details (survey/khata number, dag/khasra number, land size in hectares).
online: Complete mandatory e-KYC using Aadhaar OTP or facial recognition via PM-KISAN Mobile App.
exceptions: Former and present holders of constitutional posts
Persons who paid income tax in last assessment year
Retired persons / pensioners whose monthly pension is Rs. 10,000 or more (excluding multi-tasking staff / Class IV)
Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies

faqs.question: How much financial benefit is given under PM-KISAN every year?
faqs.answer: Under PM-KISAN, eligible farmer families receive Rs. 6,000 per year transferred directly into their Aadhaar-linked bank accounts in three equal 4-monthly installments of Rs. 2,000 each.

faqs.question: Is eKYC mandatory for PM-KISAN beneficiaries?
faqs.answer: Yes, eKYC is mandatory for all PM-KISAN registered farmers. It can be done through OTP on the portal or biometric verification at CSC or facial recognition on the PM-KISAN App.

catalog_descriptions.en: PM-KISAN gives land-holding farmer families 6000 rupees a year, paid in three instalments of 2000 rupees directly into their bank account.
catalog_descriptions.hi: पीएम-किसान भूमि धारक किसान परिवारों को प्रति वर्ष 6000 रुपये देता है, जिसका भुगतान 2000 रुपये की तीन किश्तों में सीधे उनके बैंक खाते में किया जाता है।
catalog_descriptions.ta: பிஎம்-கிசான் நிறுவனம் விவசாயக் குடும்பங்களுக்கு ஆண்டுக்கு 6000 ரூபாய் வழங்குகிறது, 2000 ரூபாய் என்ற மூன்று தவணைகளில் அவர்களின் வங்கிக் கணக்கில் நேரடியாக செலுத்தப்படுகிறது.
